name: HIVE
summary: A learning cycle connecting hindsight, insight, validation and evolution.

behavior.target: Carry verified learning into the next cycle and preserve unresolved failures.
behavior.assay: Compare a source-bound card capsule against matched factual instructions on held-out tasks. Freeze carrier, tools, budget and evaluator; record constraint violations, useful outcomes and operator corrections. See /cards/behavior-assay.json.

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: HIVE. Show a finite sequence of connected stations with an unresolved final gate. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
art.alt: Planned conceptual illustration for HIVE; no artwork generated.

behavior_contract.intent: Candidate behavior: make remembered experience change the next attempt through a testable learning cycle.
behavior_contract.when_to_use: After an observed success, failure or repeated operator correction suggests a bounded improvement.
inputs: Exact incident/output artifacts and consumer outcome
One causal hypothesis, baseline, budget and fixed validation criterion
procedure: Hindsight: reconstruct what happened from artifacts and identify uncertainty.
Insight: propose one causal explanation and a distinguishing observation.
Validation: prepare a bounded comparison of one intervention against the baseline.
Evolution: submit the observed result for existing admission; preserve rejected hypotheses and unresolved failures.
failure_modes: An experiment automatically promoted into policy

example.situation: Carriers repeatedly select index-only cards as complete instructions.
example.action: Propose a clearer missing-contract cue and compare retrieval decisions under the fixed rubric.
example.evidence: Expected: original failures, candidate revision, independent comparison and retained counterexamples.

neurosymbolic.symbolic: Connect incidents, interventions, comparisons and admission records.

frozen: Baseline, judge and acceptance criteria during comparison
evolution.fitness: Evaluate the targeted failure's recurrence and useful outcomes; recording a lesson does not establish improvement.
